headline: A law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Auburn, California, after veteran Louis A. Conter.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Auburn, California, the Louis A. Conter VA Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name and does not change the services it offers. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
